Mistral API file upload purpose accepted values

item.text:
The file upload endpoint accepts exactly:

- `"fine-tune"`
- `"batch"`
- `"ocr"`

The current API reference declares `purpose` as `"fine-tune"|"batch"|"ocr"` and includes an OCR upload example. Your type checker is likely using an outdated Mistral SDK or generated types. Update the SDK/types, or temporarily apply a narrow type override.

[ Mistral Files API reference](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/files)
